mapper.select: SELECT id, user_name, real_name, address, amount, application, item, repayment_period, area, phone, create_time, update_time FROM tb_financing_intention WHERE user_name = #{name}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_financing_intention (user_name, real_name, address, amount, application, item, repayment_period, area, phone, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{userName}, #{realName}, #{address}, #{amount}, #{application}, #{item}, #{repaymentPeriod}, #{area}, #{phone}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_financing_intention SET real_name = #{realName}, address = #{address}, amount = #{amount}, application = #{application}, item = #{item}, repayment_period = #{repaymentPeriod}, area = #{area}, phone = #{phone}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id} AND user_name = #{userName}
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT i2.id, i2.user_name, i2.real_name, i2.address, i2.amount, i2.application, i2.item, i2.repayment_period, i2.area, i2.phone, i2.create_time, i2.update_time FROM tb_financing_intention i1 JOIN tb_financing_intention i2 ON i2.address = i1.address AND i2.item = i1.item AND i2.user_name != i1.user_name WHERE i1.user_name = #{name}

SELECT f.finance_id, f.bank_id, f.own_name, f.real_name, f.phone, f.id_num, f.status, f.money, f.rate, f.repayment, f.create_time, f.update_time, f.combination_name1, f.combination_phone1, f.combination_idnum1, f.combination_name2, f.combination_phone2, f.combination_idnum2, f.file_info, b.bank_name FROM tb_finance f LEFT JOIN tb_bank b ON f.bank_id = b.bank_id WHERE f.finance_id = #{financeId}

SELECT f.finance_id, f.bank_id, f.own_name, f.real_name, f.phone, f.id_num, f.status, f.money, f.rate, f.repayment, f.create_time, f.update_time, f.combination_name1, f.combination_phone1, f.combination_idnum1, f.combination_name2, f.combination_phone2, f.combination_idnum2, f.file_info, b.bank_name FROM tb_finance f LEFT JOIN tb_bank b ON f.bank_id = b.bank_id WHERE f.own_name = #{ownName} ORDER BY f.create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_finance (bank_id, own_name, real_name, phone, id_num, status, money, rate, repayment, create_time, update_time, combination_name1, combination_phone1, combination_idnum1, combination_name2, combination_phone2, combination_idnum2, file_info) VALUES (#{bankId}, #{ownName}, #{realName}, #{phone}, #{idNum}, #{status}, #{money}, #{rate}, #{repayment}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{combinationName1}, #{combinationPhone1}, #{combinationIdnum1}, #{combinationName2}, #{combinationPhone2}, #{combinationIdnum2}, #{fileInfo})

SELECT f.finance_id, f.bank_id, f.own_name, f.real_name, f.phone, f.id_num, f.status, f.money, f.rate, f.repayment, f.create_time, f.update_time, f.combination_name1, f.combination_phone1, f.combination_idnum1, f.combination_name2, f.combination_phone2, f.combination_idnum2, f.file_info, b.bank_name FROM tb_finance f LEFT JOIN tb_bank b ON f.bank_id = b.bank_id WHERE f.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{realName}, '%') ORDER BY f.create_time DESC
